answer: Error-correlation clustering spots clones by how they fail. Each epoch every seat answers a fresh batch of hard questions seeded with lantern items, traps whose correct reading is subtle. Independent agents miss different lanterns; copies of one model miss the same ones. Seats whose error vectors match within a threshold fuse into one crystal, and each crystal is paid as a single seat, measured against an anchor set of answers from established graders. Each extra fake therefore needs its own distinct model and pipeline, retested every epoch, which bulk-renting one model cannot supply.
